headline: The goodnight list your two-year-old insists on, every single night
items: Goodnight to the dog, already asleep and unbothered
Goodnight to the light switch, which only they get to flip now
Goodnight to Grandma through the phone, kiss on the screen and all
Goodnight to you last, because you're the one who stays
turn: One night the list gets shorter, and nobody announces it.
